hanzi: 对话一,别做白日梦。
pinyin: Duìhuà yī, bié zuò bái rì mèng.
en: Episode 1: Stop Daydreaming

hanzi: Conversation one, stop day dreaming。
现在几点了?
pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnle?
en: What time is it now?

hanzi: 我看看,差不多十点半。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn kàn, chàbùduō shí diǎn bàn.
en: Let me see, it's almost half past ten.

hanzi: 这么说,我们已经等了快半个小时了。
pinyin: Zhème shuō, wǒmen yǐjīng děngle kuài bàn gè xiǎoshíliǎo.
en: So, we've been waiting for almost half an hour.

hanzi: 对啊,刚才广播说这趟飞机会晚点。
pinyin: Duì a, gāngcái guǎngbò shuō zhè tàng fēijī huì wǎndiǎn.
en: Yes, the announcement just now said that the flight will be delayed.

hanzi: 怎么,你没有耐心了吗?
pinyin: Zěnme, nǐ méiyǒu nàixīnle ma?
en: Are you running out of patience

hanzi: 早就没耐心了。
en: I have long run out of patience.
pinyin: Zǎo jiù méi nàixīnle.

hanzi: 在这里坐着,一边等飞机,一边玩手机,真是无聊。
pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ zuòzhe, yībiān děng fēijī, yībiān wán shǒujī, zhēnshi wúliáo.
en: It's really boring to sit here, waiting for the flight, and playing with my mobile phone.

hanzi: 你看,开始登机了,快拿好行李箱,我们去排队吧。
pinyin: Nǐ kàn, kāishǐ dēng jīle, kuài ná hǎo xínglǐ xiāng, wǒmen qù páiduì ba.
en: Look, boarding has started. Get your suitcases quickly and let's go queue up.

hanzi: 太好了,对了,我的登机牌在哪儿?
pinyin: Tài hǎole, duìle, wǒ de dēng jī pái zài nǎ'er?
en: Great, by the way, where is my boarding pass?

hanzi: 别担心,在我的包里。
pinyin: Bié dānxīn, zài wǒ de bāo lǐ.
en: Don't worry, it's in my bag.

hanzi: 好多人啊！ 我觉得这趟航班会有点挤。
pinyin: Hǎoduō rén a! Wǒ juédé zhè tàng hángbān huì yǒudiǎn jǐ.
en: So many people! I think this flight will be a bit crowded.

hanzi: 今天是星期六，当然很几。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqíliù, dāngrán hěn jǐ.
en: Today is Saturday, of course.

hanzi: 只是，如果我们的飞机票是商务舱，或者头等舱，该有多好啊?
pinyin: Zhǐshì, rúguǒ wǒmen de fēijī piào shì shāngwù cāng, huòzhě tóuděng cāng, gāi yǒu duō hǎo a?
en: But, how great would it be if our plane tickets were business class or first class?

hanzi: 别做白日梦了。
pinyin: Bié zuò bái rì mèngle.
en: Stop daydreaming.

hanzi: 商务舱和头等舱是有钱人坐的。
pinyin: Shāngwù cāng hé tóuděng cāng shì yǒu qián rén zuò de.
en: Business class and first class are for rich people.

hanzi: 我们就好好坐经济舱吧。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiù hǎohǎo zuò jīngjì cāng ba.
en: Let's just take economy class.

hanzi: 白日梦是暂时的,因为我相信,
pinyin: Bái rì mèng shì zhànshí de, yīnwèi wǒ xiāngxìn,
en: Daydreams are temporary because I believe,

hanzi: 将来我们一定会有钱坐商务舱和头等舱。
pinyin: Jiānglái wǒmen yīdìng huì yǒu qián zuò shāngwù cāng hé tóuděng cāng.
en: We will definitely have the money to fly business class and first class in the future.

hanzi: 好的,那你就努力挣钱吧。
pinyin: Hǎo de, nà nǐ jiù nǔlì zhèng qián ba.
en: Okay, then you can work hard to make money.

hanzi: 把白日梦变成现实。
pinyin: Bǎ bái rì mèng biàn chéng xiànshí.
en: Turn your daydreams into reality.

hanzi: 当然。
哎,我真后悔没有托运这个行李箱
pinyin: Āi, wǒ zhēn hòuhuǐ méiyǒu tuōyùn zhège xínglǐ xiāng.
en: Oh, I really regret not checking in this suitcase.

hanzi: 为什么?
我担心飞机上行李架的空间不够大。
pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn fēijī shàng xínglǐ jià de kōngjiān bùgòu dà.
en: I'm worried that there isn't enough space in the overhead bins on the plane.

hanzi: 这是一架大飞机,我觉得不会有问题。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī jià dà fēijī, wǒ juédé bù huì yǒu wèntí.
en: It's a big plane, I don't think it will be a problem.

hanzi: 你别担心。
pinyin: Nǐ bié dānxīn.
en: Don't worry

hanzi: 对了,你看看,我们的座位在哪里?
pinyin: Duìle, nǐ kàn kàn, wǒmen de zuòwèi zài nǎlǐ?
en: By the way, look, where are our seats?

hanzi: 我的座位号是58A,靠窗户,你的座位号是58C,靠走廊。
pinyin: Wǒ de zuòwèi hào shì 58A, kào chuānghù, nǐ de zuòwèi hào shì 58C, kào zǒuláng.
en: My seat number is 58A, by the window, and your seat number is 58C, by the corridor.

hanzi: 真倒霉,我最讨厌靠走廊的座位。
pinyin: Zhēn dǎoméi, wǒ zuì tǎoyàn kào zǒuláng de zuòwèi.
en: What a shame, I hate aisle seats.

hanzi: 你介意跟我换一下吗?
pinyin: Nǐ jièyì gēn wǒ huàn yīxià ma?
en: Would you mind switching with me?

hanzi: 当然不介意,你想坐哪里就坐哪里。
pinyin: Dāngrán bù jièyì, nǐ xiǎng zuò nǎlǐ jiùzuò nǎlǐ.
en: Of course I don't mind, you can sit wherever you want.

hanzi: 果然是英国绅士，多谢！
pinyin: Guǒrán shì yīngguó shēnshì, duōxiè!
en: He is indeed a British gentleman, thank you very much!

hanzi: 哪里哪里?
pinyin: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ
en: Thank you

hanzi: 其实，我更喜欢坐靠走廊的座位，因为我的腿长可以伸腿。
pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ gèng xǐhuān zuò kào zǒuláng de zuòwèi, yīnwèi wǒ de tuǐ cháng kěyǐ shēntuǐ.
en: Actually, I prefer the aisle seats because I have long legs and can stretch my legs.

hanzi: 反正我没有你的蜘蛛长腿，我只想坐在窗边看风景。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng wǒ méiyǒu nǐ de zhīzhū zhǎng tuǐ, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng zuò zài chuāng biān kàn fēngjǐng.
en: Anyway, I don't have your spider legs. I just want to sit by the window and watch the scenery.
